top.description: Player 1 background (Luffy + Zoro). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A highly detailed, epic 2D anime illustration in the modern Wano arc art style of One Piece, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified scene of the wooden deck of the Thousand Sunny ship. On the far left, Monkey D. Luffy stands in a heroic, energetic stance, smiling broadly, holding his iconic straw hat on his head, surrounded by wind gusts and glowing golden sparkles. On the far right, Roronoa Zoro is standing in a combat stance, wielding his three katanas (one in his mouth), surrounded by a swirling green sword aura and cherry blossom petals. The entire middle-center area of the polished wooden deck of the ship is completely empty, clean, and free of details, showing only the rich wood texture. Saturated colors, dramatic sunset sky over a tropical blue ocean, dynamic cel-shading, bold clean outlines. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Barbanegra + Akainu). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
bottom.prompt: A highly detailed, dramatic 2D anime illustration in the modern Wano arc art style of One Piece, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified scene of the crumbling, ruined battlefield of Marineford. On the far left, Marshall D. Teach 'Blackbeard' is laughing maniacally, surrounded by rising vortexes of dark gravity shadows and crackling white air fractures. On the far right, Fleet Admiral Akainu stands with a furious scowl, his fist and arm completely transformed into bubbling, dripping orange-red molten volcanic magma and black smoke. The entire middle-center area of the battlefield is a flat, clean, dark-grey cracked stone surface with no objects or details. Intense dramatic lighting, red-hot volcanic glow and dark purple highlights, bold cel-shading. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Luffy vs Kaido jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A stunning and epic 2D anime scene of a card match in the classic One Piece style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Two characters are seated properly and facing each other across a stone battlefield table on the stormy rooftop of Onigashima, playing a game of Magic. On the left, Monkey D. Luffy (Wano outfit) sits upright, looking intensely focused at his cards. On the right, Kaido in his human-beast form sits facing him, studying his own cards. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering battlefield is laid out: rows of fantasy cards, with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degree angle to show they are tapped, alongside neat deck libraries and graveyard piles. The background is an epic storm with crackling red lightning and dark clouds swirling around the colossal skull dome. Vibrant cel-shading, dynamic shadows. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
